entry_lifecycle.catalyst_logic: US GDP and personal income at 08:30 are the gate. A soft pair lets the March hike premium come out. A hot pair with Brent still near 91 is the cover.

entry_rationale: The dollar-bloc stress legs are already extended and the cash curve has already rallied. The price that has not cheapened is March 2027 SOFR at 4.525 versus cash at 3.92.
entry_thesis: Receive March 2027 SOFR at the 4.525 implied yield. Cash yields have already fallen, with the US two-year at 4.63 and the ten-year at 4.91, while December SOFR at 4.28 and March at 4.525 still sit well above cash SOFR at 3.92. Euro, Australian dollar and New Zealand dollar are already extended stress legs, so the open is the lagging hike strip rather than another chase in spot.

events.rationale: The dollar-bloc stress legs are already extended and the cash curve has already rallied. The price that has not cheapened is March 2027 SOFR at 4.525 versus cash at 3.92.

Cover the full March 2027 SOFR receive. Cash SOFR is 3.94 and the March implied is still 4.525, so the position fades a hike path rather than expressing a slowdown, and the December meeting price firmed 6.6bp overnight and 11.7bp on the week to about 44bp of tightening and a 4.31 post rate. Brent at 94.61 and an ECB that says it cannot fall behind the curve push that path against the receive. Euro, the Australian dollar and the New Zealand dollar are already extended, and cash yields have already rallied, so nothing else is a cleaner defensive replacement.
